metric_semantics.false_admission_rate: false durable writes divided by candidates expected not to be admitted; null when that denominator is zero
metric_semantics.recall_at_k: relevant labels recalled in the top k divided by relevant labels; null for an expected no-result case or an empty relevance set
metric_semantics.precision_at_k: relevant labels in the returned top k divided by returned labels; null when no labels were returned, for expected no-result cases, or with no relevance set
metric_semantics.scope_leakage_rate: foreign-scope matches divided by foreign-scope records under test; null when no scope-isolation control exists
metric_semantics.stale_or_forgotten_recall_rate: stale or forgotten labels recalled divided by stale or forgotten labels under test; null when no stale or forgotten control exists
metric_semantics.harmful_over_retrieval_rate: harmful labels recalled divided by harmful labels under test; null when no harmful control exists
metric_semantics.correction_compliance_rate: correction cases where the replacement is recalled and the superseded target is not; null when no correction case exists
metric_semantics.memory_context_characters: characters in the production ContextBuilder memory projection; per-case zero means no memory block was projected
metric_semantics.memory_context_count: complete memory records projected by ContextBuilder; records are never partially truncated
metric_semantics.direct_answer_predicate_pass_rate: cases passing exact/contains/absent direct answer predicates; no LLM judge is used
metric_semantics.no_result_correct: actual empty recall equals the case expectation for enabled-memory recall cases; disabled-memory controls are not applicable and excluded from the denominator
